newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $281 mln loans for Philippines.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $281 mln loans for Philippines.

text.p: The World Bank said Tuesday it had approved loans totaling $281 million for four projects benefiting the Philippines' infrastructure, education and agriculture.

Of the total, $60 million will finance the Subic Bay Freeport Project, $113.4 million will finance elementary education, $58 million will finance a water resources development project, and $50 million will finance an agrarian reform project.
The loans are for 20 years, with a five-year grace period at the bank's standard LIBOR-based interest rate for single-currency loans.
